pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft edge gradients; shapes are larger and more defined at the base of the neck, becoming smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming tri-directional and quadri-directional junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-torso with slight widening at the base of the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour visible along the upper neck and shoulder ridge where the mane interacts with the background sky.
